raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread/summarized the WebSurfer’s prior results and stated that no cause of death was provided, even though the NPR result in Step 4 explicitly said Peter Matthiessen “died of acute myeloid leukemia.” This oversight led to flawed synthesis, later compounding into a specific but incorrect subtype claim (Step 7 mistakenly citing “acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL)” and misattributing it to reputable sources). This failure to correctly interpret and reconcile sources steered the process toward an incorrect cause detail instead of the correct general cause, leukemia.
